A dot, a Grok Bot and Claude Duet, all reading the same inbox, and three different replies to one client.
This is The One-Person Company, lesson four: your AI org chart.
In this lesson: the five boxes every solo business needs, the role card, and the weekly review.
You sit at the top, and you approve anything external or about money.
Under you: chief of staff, sales and customers, marketing and content, finance assistant, and product and website.
You don't fill all five on day one.
Fill the box that costs you the most hours first.
Each filled box gets one tool and one owner, written on a six-line role card.
Then, every Friday, take fifteen minutes: read the logs, count misses, change one thing, and prune.
After four clean weeks, an agent can take on a narrow action, but sends and money stay with you.
First, the shape of a one-person company.
